artifact_observations.reasoning: The controls on the top of the handle are vague and 'mushy'. They lack the crisp edges, distinct separation, or legible markings (numbers/symbols) expected on a real appliance. They look like melted plastic rather than functional mechanical parts.

artifact_observations.location: Base of the iron / Soleplate interface
artifact_observations.reasoning: The transition between the white plastic body and the black soleplate/base is inconsistent. On the left side, there is a thick black band, but it seems to merge into the white plastic without a clean seam. The geometry of the base appears slightly warped rather than rigid.
The coiled chain/rope object has repetitive, slightly nonsensical geometry. The links do not connect logically in 3D space, suggesting a generative artifact in the background prop.

To rigorously inspect the 'mushy' controls and base seams for micro-artifacts and texture inconsistencies.
To verify the physical contact between the iron and the fabric, ensuring no floating or bleeding edges at the base.
To check if the background chain/rope has valid topological connectivity or if it is a fused mess.

focus_areas: Clarity and definition of the temperature dial/buttons
Seam integrity between the white body and black base
Contact shadow and edge sharpness where the iron meets the fabric
Logical structure of the background coiled object
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'controls' on the handle. In AI images, these often fail to render as distinct mechanical parts. Also, scrutinize the black base; ensure it doesn't look like it's melting into the white plastic. The background object is likely irrelevant to the class label but serves as a good indicator of overall generation quality.
